title: Restriction of a Boolean circuit
statement: For natural numbers $m,n$, an assignment $p : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$, and a Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ variables, its restriction to $m$ variables is the circuit defined recursively as follows: a literal with index less than $m$ is retained with that index viewed among the $m$ variables, while a literal with index at least $m$ is replaced by a node with no children whose tag is the value of the literal under $p$. Each internal node keeps its tag, and the restriction is applied to each child.
